hook: Rare *Indian skimmers* spotted at Manjeera, 60 km from Hyderabad
fact: Birders spotted *three rare Indian skimmers* at Manjeera reservoir, about 60 km from Hyderabad.
twist: Skimmers usually winter on coasts after breeding near rivers like the Chambal; earlier this year only a lone bird was seen at Kishtareddypet.
tldr: Three birdwatchers photographed three Indian skimmers in the Manjeera reservoir backwaters on a holiday trip.

beats.what: Three Indian skimmers were seen flying over Manjeera backwaters.
beats.why: These migratory birds usually winter in a few coastal spots in the South, West and East.
beats.care: Birders say more may join if the site suits them, making Manjeera a weekend birding spot.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today: The same trio photographed skimmers at mid-Manair in Sircilla last year and in Bhairavapalem earlier.

cards.q: Should Manjeera backwaters get protected birding zones?

qs: Will more skimmers arrive in the coming weeks, and how will fishing activity affect them?

facts.t: Skimmers usually move in large groups; the team spotted only *3 individuals*.

viz.verdict: Rare but repeat visits across Telangana

watch: Whether more skimmers join the three at Manjeera over the winter.
